name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.evalStep_eq_eval
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type} (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ)
  (I :
    DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
  (a : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.k γ) → A) (d : A) (j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes γ)) →
    Eq.{1}
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.evalStep γ I a d
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.buildList (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.evalStep γ I a d) j) j)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Term.eval I a (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD γ hv j))

source.code:
theorem evalStep_eq_eval (hv : γ.Valid) (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A)
    (a : Fin γ.k → A) (d : A) :
    ∀ j, j < γ.nodes.length →
      γ.evalStep I a d (buildList (γ.evalStep I a d) j) j = (γ.termD hv j).eval I a := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
      intro hj
      unfold evalStep
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
      cases hnd : γ.nodes[j] with
      | src i =>
          obtain ⟨hi, ht⟩ := γ.decode_src hv j i hj hnd
          rw [ht]
          dsimp only
          rw [dif_pos hi]
          rfl
      | app f args =>
          obtain ⟨hf, hlen, hargs, ht⟩ := γ.decode_app hv j f args hj hnd
          rw [ht]
          dsimp only
          rw [dif_pos hf]
          simp only [Term.eval]
          congr 1
          funext i
          have hi : i.1 < args.length := by
            have : i.1 < γ.arityOf f := i.2
            omega
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
          have ha : args[i.1] < j := hargs _ (List.getElem_mem hi)
          rw [buildList_getD _ _ _ ha]
          exact ih _ ha (lt_trans ha hj)
